MacBook Pro 14-inch — Model Comparison

Not sure which model to go for? Here is a quick side-by-side breakdown of all three MacBook Pro 14-inch options available at applemac.pk:

The 14-inch M5 model is powered by the M5 chip featuring a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU. It comes with 16GB of unified memory as standard, configurable up to 32GB. Storage starts at 512GB and can be expanded up to 4TB. This model offers up to 16 hours of web browsing battery life.

The 14-inch M5 Pro model is equipped with the more advanced M5 Pro chip, offering a 15- or 18-core CPU and a 16- or 20-core GPU. It starts with 24GB of unified memory and can be configured up to 64GB, with higher options available in certain configurations. Storage begins at 512GB and can go up to 4TB or more depending on customization. It delivers up to 14 hours of web usage.The 14-inch M5 Max model features the powerful M5 Max chip with an 18-core CPU and a 32- or 40-core GPU. It starts with 36GB of unified memory and can be configured up to 128GB. Storage options typically begin at 1TB and can be expanded up to 8TB. This model provides up to 13 hours of web browsing battery life.

MacBook Pro 14-inch M5 vs M4: What Has Changed?

Already own an M4 MacBook Pro 14-inch and wondering if it is worth upgrading? Here is what the M5 generation brings to the table:

• CPU: New super cores deliver faster single-threaded and multi-threaded performance than M4

• GPU: Neural Accelerators embedded in every GPU core for dramatically faster AI processing

• AI Speed: Up to 8x faster AI performance compared to the M1 family

• SSD: Up to 2x faster storage read and write speeds than M4 generation

• Memory Bandwidth: M5 Max hits 614GB/s — higher than the 546GB/s on M4 Max

• Storage Start: M5 Pro begins at 1TB and M5 Max begins at 2TB — better value out of the box

• Wireless: M5 Pro and M5 Max gain Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 via the new Apple N1 wireless chip

• Sustainability: All MacBook Pro 14-inch models now use 100% recycled aluminium

Which MacBook Pro 14-inch Is Right for You?

• MacBook Pro 14" M5 — Best for students, developers, photographers, and everyday power users who want a fast and portable machine

• MacBook Pro 14" M5 Pro — Ideal for video editors, music producers, and software engineers who need Thunderbolt 5 and serious memory headroom

• MacBook Pro 14" M5 Max — Built for 3D artists, AI/ML engineers, and professional filmmakers who demand the absolute best performance in a 14-inch body
